environment: Real .NET providers, win-x64 self-contained, Wine shared with running FFXIV; system certificate verification enabled
method: 6 EN→RU dialogue samples, 2 JA→RU samples, 1 auto→RU sample, 4 reverse/other language pairs per service. Timing includes initial session setup on first call. A small functional and qualitative probe, not a comprehensive quality benchmark.

quality_notes.TranslateCom: Best rendering of both Japanese samples among these candidates. EN→RU dialogue still sometimes literal.
quality_notes.ModernMT: Fast independent EN→RU reserve; both Japanese dialogue samples contained meaning-changing errors.
quality_notes.Tencent: Literal EN→RU and incomplete Japanese output; opt-in. Uses yi.qq.com with valid TLS.
quality_notes.Volcengine: Literal output, including a bad Japanese idiom; opt-in.
quality_notes.Alibaba: Slowest cold start in this run; quality varied between runs; opt-in.
quality_notes.ChromeTranslatorAPI: Not integrated. Brave headless API advertised downloadable but Translator.create(en,ru) failed with NotSupportedError. Chrome for Testing availability timed out. Visible isolated browser probes exited before testing.
